ranked_plan.claim: classViolations exempts a changed rule by its WORKING lifetime, so a branch that appends lifetime="task" to a protected doctrine rule's marker gets zero CheckPolicy diagnostics in gated and strict mode, and the default doctrine-only check stops running the rule — a branch can switch off any protected gate, contradicting CheckPolicy's 'a branch cannot weaken the mode'.
ranked_plan.fix: Exempt task-lifetime rules only when the base side holds no doctrine rule with that id: pass base rule lifetimes into classViolations and skip the exemption when the base rule is doctrine; add a policy_test case that demotes ACDSL-PLAN-100 with lifetime="task" (gated and strict).
